items.title: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) Sees £330 Million NHS Contract Draw New UK Rivals
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (NasdaqGS:PLTR) faces new competition for the £330 million NHS Federated Data Platform contract from UK-led groups. A British consortium called Drystone Health AI Collaboration is mobilizing to challenge Palantir's position on the NHS data platform bid. Other technology suppliers, including Quantexa and Oracle Health, are also preparing proposals for the same large-scale NHS data project.
